name: opencode
description: Installs the opencode AI coding agent (anomalyco/opencode) at an exact version, checked against a sha256 you supply, with its update checks turned off. There are no default pins.

version.description: opencode version to install, without the v of the release tag (e.g. 1.19.5). Set it with its sha256 here, or as CLI_OPENCODE_VERSION in the image environment, or in the pins file. There is no default.

sha256_amd64.description: sha256 of the release's opencode-linux-x64.tar.gz, needed on amd64. Set it here, or as CLI_OPENCODE_SHA256_AMD64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

sha256_arm64.description: sha256 of the release's opencode-linux-arm64.tar.gz, needed on arm64. Set it here, or as CLI_OPENCODE_SHA256_ARM64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read when neither the options nor the image environment set a pin. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.
